snippets: |version1 = Red
|version2 = Blue

A '''demonic symbol''' is a symbol conjured by [[Zalcano]]. When players stand on them, the orange ones deal damage and drain [[run energy]], whilst the blue ones give a 50% damage boost to [[imbued tephra]] thrown at Zalcano's shield or a [[Golem (Zalcano)|golem]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1477445513666564104|date=2 January 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102477|archivedate=10 June 2023|quote=I don't see an accuracy effect in the code, though you may like to try other devs for a second opinion in case I missed something. For damage: [Can increase it by 50% of whatever your max hit would have been.]}}

*Zalcano will summon blue and orange [[demonic symbol]]s. If a player is standing on a blue demonic symbol when attacking Zalcano with [[imbued tephra]], it will increase the player's damage by 50%. The orange demonic symbols, however, should be avoided: These will damage the player as well as reduce their run energy if they pass through it or stand in it. After the first three ticks upon spawning, they deal increasing damage every tick (maxing in the low 20s) if a player stands within them and can very quickly kill players that are not paying attention.
